# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolchild / student  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a cute little lad with a dark, sullen face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

He is an independent, stubborn, and rather mischievous boy who makes up his own mind about things. He displays a scornful air of toleration and contempt toward female teachers, holding the firm belief that girl teachers are no good. Despite his disruptive tendencies, he respects discipline and shows a change in perspective when handled firmly.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Independent  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>
- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Disdainful of female teachers  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>
- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye attended the Avonlea school under the instruction of Anne Shirley. From the beginning, he held his new teacher in contempt and behaved with a scornful air of obedience, believing that female teachers were useless. He frequently disrupted the classroom, making negative remarks about Anne's hair and facial expressions, telling others that her hair was red and asserting that she always looked cross. While his behavior disturbed Anne, she attempted to win him over with patience and kindness. The turning point came when Anthony's persistent disobedience pushed Anne to administer a whipping; rather than harboring resentment, Anthony respected the firm discipline, declaring that the whipping was as good as a man's and conceding that Anne was worthwhile after all.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c11 P21](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0021), [v2 c11 P23](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0023), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
